integrity: The proof uses the source's exact basis expansion, pointwise bound, Bloch norm definition, and Dunkl operator identity. Sharpness of the pointwise bound on the positive real axis is reconstructed by an exact Pochhammer convolution, after which the norm reduces to a one-variable calculus maximum. The large-degree constant follows from a standard gamma-ratio asymptotic; finite numerical checks are only consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: The result computes the lambda-Bloch norm of each individual canonical basis vector for lambda>0. It does not determine norms of arbitrary linear combinations, unconditional basis constants, or coefficient-space characterizations. The classical lambda=0 endpoint is not part of the stated nonclassical claim.
title: Exact canonical-basis norms in the \(\lambda\)-Bloch space
